metadata.name: Silk Blend Gradient
metadata.description: Pure CSS gradient background in the Silk Blend style, made with the 21st.dev Gradient Builder. 4-color palette (#000000, #820853, #0F0609, #2C1A00). Features: film grain. A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections, cards, and page backgrounds.
